reason: 21 implemented tools use Tag Manager v2 plus Portuguese help, OAuth profiles and read-only audit; specific guard, audit and combine deficiencies recorded.
exposure: All 21 tools always registered; default readonly rejects classified writes at call time, --write permits them; remove/delete/publish also require confirm=true. No registration filtering.
limitations: Offline invocation of the real SDK tools/list request handler after registerAllTools; SDK 1.29.0 and dependencies installed from committed package-lock.json. No transport handshake, OAuth, GTM operation or network API validation performed.

Advertised inputSchema is preserved verbatim, including defaults, unions, additionalProperties and recursive local $refs. ParameterSchema superRefine rejects nesting depth >3 at runtime; this custom bound is omitted by JSON Schema conversion (src/schemas/ParameterSchema.ts lines 61-70).

All 21 tools remain advertised in readonly mode. --write enables actions create/update/remove/delete/publish/createVersion/combine/moveTagId/resolveConflict/sync/revert/link/setLatest/undelete/reauthorize; only remove/delete/publish require confirm. combine is described as destructive but receives no confirm requirement; user-permission update also needs no confirm. quickPreview is not write-classified. Auth login/switch/logout are outside guards.

gtm_audit_container does not follow pagination for resources or workspace selection; orphan triggers consider firingTriggerId only, ignoring blockingTriggerId; variable usage searches only serialized tags/triggers, missing inter-variable references. Latest version header is labeled last published even though it is latest rather than live, and no publication date is actually reported despite the description.
gtm_container combineConfig requires fromContainerId/toContainerId, which are spread unmodified into API combine whose required other-container parameter is containerId; this action is likely broken.
gtm_workspace resolveConflict client branch uses TransformationSchema instead of ClientSchema. quickPreview returns the API QuickPreviewResponse rather than constructing the advertised preview URL.

gtm_help ignores topic. Several list handlers (account/container/destination) do not follow API page tokens. Runtime requires IDs/config for specific actions although advertised schemas generally mark them optional.

The audit labels the latest version header as the last published version, but latest and live versions can differ; it also does not inspect variable-to-variable references or blocking trigger references.

tools.name: gtm_auth
tools.description: Gerencia QUAL conta Google está logada (multi-conta por perfil). Use quando precisar trocar de cliente: cada cliente/email vira um 'perfil' salvo. Ações: 'status' (perfil ativo), 'list' (todos os perfis e emails), 'login' (autentica um perfil — abre o navegador com o seletor de contas Google), 'switch' (troca o perfil ativo sem refazer login), 'logout' (remove o token de um perfil).

action.description: status: mostra a conta ativa. list: lista perfis salvos. login: autentica/reautentica um perfil (abre navegador). switch: troca o perfil ativo. logout: remove um perfil.

profile.description: Nome do perfil (ex: 'cliente-x', 'live-conta2'). Obrigatório para 'login' e 'switch'. Para 'logout' usa o ativo se omitido. Dica: use o nome do cliente como perfil.

tools.behavior: Reads saved OAuth profiles, opens login, switches the active profile, or removes local tokens; auth changes bypass GTM write guards.

tools.name: gtm_audit_container
tools.description: Auditoria humana de um container GTM. Retorna relatório em markdown com: contagem de tags/triggers/variáveis, tags pausadas, tags sem trigger, triggers órfãos, variáveis não referenciadas e data da última publicação. Tudo read-only.

tools.behavior: Reads one workspace and first pages of tags, triggers and variables, then builds a Markdown heuristic audit using latest version header rather than live published version.

waitForTags.description: Whether or not to delay form submissions or link opening until all of the tags have fired. Only valid for Form Submission and Link Click triggers.

checkValidation.description: Whether or not to only fire tags if the form submit or link click event is not cancelled by some other event handler. Only valid for Form Submission and Link Click triggers.

waitForTagsTimeout.description: How long to wait (in ms) for tags to fire when 'waits_for_tags' above evaluates to true. Only valid for Form Submission and Link Click triggers.

uniqueTriggerId.description: Globally unique id of the trigger that auto-generates this (a Form Submit, Link Click or Timer listener) if any. Only valid for Form Submit, Link Click and Timer triggers.

eventName.description: Name of the GTM event that is fired. Only valid for Timer triggers.

interval.description: Time between triggering recurring Timer Events (in ms). Only valid for Timer triggers.

limit.description: Limit of the number of GTM events this Timer Trigger will fire. Only valid for Timer triggers.

selector.description: A click trigger CSS selector. Only valid for AMP Click trigger.

intervalSeconds.description: Time between Timer Events to fire (in seconds). Only valid for AMP Timer trigger.

maxTimerLengthSeconds.description: Max time to fire Timer Events (in seconds). Only valid for AMP Timer trigger.

verticalScrollPercentageList.description: List of integer percentage values for scroll triggers. Fires when each percentage is reached when scrolled vertically. Only valid for AMP scroll triggers.

horizontalScrollPercentageList.description: List of integer percentage values for scroll triggers. Fires when each percentage is reached when scrolled horizontally. Only valid for AMP scroll triggers.

visibilitySelector.description: A visibility trigger CSS selector. Only valid for AMP Visibility trigger.

visiblePercentageMin.description: A visibility trigger minimum percent visibility. Only valid for AMP Visibility trigger.

visiblePercentageMax.description: A visibility trigger maximum percent visibility. Only valid for AMP Visibility trigger.

continuousTimeMinMilliseconds.description: A visibility trigger minimum continuous visible time (ms). Only valid for AMP Visibility trigger.

totalTimeMinMilliseconds.description: A visibility trigger minimum total visible time (ms). Only valid for AMP Visibility trigger.
